ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution; approximately 85% high-intensity white/light-grey pixels across the central lobes against 15% low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels localized at the periphery and center.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous white field across both lobes. Dark pigmentation forms a continuous boundary at the trailing and leading edges. A significant vertical dark pigmentation feature originates at the median notch and extends towards the peduncle. Numerous small, isolated dark focal spots are distributed stochastically across the white surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped depression with a calculated vertex angle of approximately 40 degrees; depth is significant relative to total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-to-medium amplitude serrations visible along the entire trailing edge boundary; peaks are most pronounced on the distal third of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curve originating from the median notch, transitioning to a straight linear trajectory towards the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular dark pixel clusters (stipple-like) scattered across both lobes; highest density observed on the mid-right lobe and surrounding the central dark streak.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One prominent, thick horizontal dark linear disruption on the mid-left lobe; secondary thin linear marks visible on the right lobe near the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent dark linear scar on the left lobe; irregular dark pigmentation cluster surrounding the median notch area.
other_distinctive_markers: A distinct vertical dark pigmentation 'streak' or 'vein' bisecting the center of the fluke starting from the median notch.
